import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    w = 5.0/12.0
    g = (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t**2 + params[3]*t**3 + params[4]*np.sin(w*t)
         + params[5]*np.cos(w*t) + params[6]*np.exp(-t) + params[7]*np.log(t)
         + params[8]*np.sqrt(t) + params[9]*t*np.sin(w*t))
    return g/P + 0.547*P*np.log(P) + 0.648*t
